name: qa-cycle
description: The QA cycle spine. Owns the single session-state file (state.md) for a project in qa-workspace, and a PreToolUse gate that refuses any write to it the spec's transition table (docs/specs/qa-cycle-state-machine.md) does not permit from the current phase. Human-only transitions require a matching verdict token minted by signoff. A SessionStart hook reports the current phase of any project in flight.
